_comment: Checked-in baseline throughput (peak Mops/s) for kvstore tasks, tagged by the hardware tier they were measured on. Each baseline runs at its most-favorable published config, with per-key workload matched to the task and crash durability no stronger than the task's requirement card. Values marked null are TODO: measure on the reference box and fill in (do NOT fabricate).

gcp-n2-standard-64.cpu: 64 vCPU (2 sockets x 16 cores x 2 HT)
gcp-n2-standard-64.storage: NVMe SSD RAID at the scratch dir
gcp-n2-standard-64.numa: 2 NUMA nodes; benchmark pinned to node 0
